scope: Optional bounded source facade detail on registered host walls; broader building/storefront recovery remains open

normalization.scaling: No source rescale; imported hierarchy baked once; rigid unit basis on host wall
normalization.wall_host: Retained exact EPSG:3448 OSM w375070825:0 cell1:0 wall4 14.870m height9.8m
normalization.bounds: 3 modules per eligible host; 32 hosts/cell; 3 cached ArrayMeshes; 3 MultiMeshes/cell; visibility100m
normalization.window_mask: Face-constant UV2 first 3.2m column +3.15m row; sentinels(-1000,-1000) retain fallback elsewhere; 100m shader cutoff restores distant fallback
normalization.collision: Original wall/roof mesh collider preserved; measured bay AABB box at rigid source pose, near-distance collision only

validation.headless: reference_building_test PASS required canonical media, cached UV/material, registered geometry unchanged, rigid fit, external wall, host+bay rays, near/distant collision, unload/reload, rebase, 32-host limit and unattached-host masks; building_streamer_test PASS
validation.render: reference_building_render_test PASS six Compatibility frames; actual MultiMesh transform match, canonical rebase/reload, unchanged source host geometry, byte-identical130m fallback raster
validation.asset_absent: Independent no-media project reference_building_test PASS source_media=false; no attachment nodes, all UV2 sentinels and unchanged registered wall/roof/UV

limitations: One retained registered OSM host; broader national visual/performance acceptance open
Host height inferred from source levels and foundation from DSM
Source photographic window cards are modest-distance optional detail, not near-view architecture acceptance
No physical Android device runtime acceptance
